changelog: **Alchemy namecard tracker.** The always-open tracker is now a compact magical alchemy namecard: a gold filigree border, dark parchment with a faint arcane gradient, a slowly rotating sigil behind your portrait in a gold ring, your name in class color, an Alchemists guild tag, and level plus role. **Available names under the count.** Below "N guildmates available" the tracker shows a compact, wrapping row of names in class colors (up to two lines, then "+N more"). **Status is labeled, and resets on login.** A Status label sits next to the status pills on the tracker and the Guild tab. **Gear upgrades are easier to read.** Item IDs are no longer shown on Gear rows. **Dungeon icons.** Each dungeon uses its official LFG / loading-screen art (`Interface\LFGFrame\LFGIcon-...`) when the client has it, cropped and masked to a circle.
